name: Mocuba

queries.query: Mocuba Mozambique cadastral parcel map land registry GIS official
queries.result: First-party discovery found an official PDUL municipal assessment stating that the Conselho Municipal da Cidade de Mocuba uses ArcGIS for land-information management, with one shapefile per bairro and 20 Access databases containing talhão data. The official MOZGIS Mocuba service exposed only health/concentration-point and INE locality-boundary layers, not parcels.

queries.query: Mocuba Moçambique cadastro predial mapa parcelas município registo cadastral
queries.result: A pesquisa oficial em português found the same PDUL evidence for Mocuba's municipal cadastral ArcGIS/shapefile and Access systems, plus the official MOZGIS portal and an official citizen-service description saying DUAT applications are made through the municipality. No public Mocuba parcel endpoint or safe ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

registryCustodian.name: Conselho Municipal da Cidade de Mocuba (CMCM), municipal cadastro/land-information function
registryCustodian.scope: Local municipal custodian evidenced by the official PDUL assessment: ArcGIS land-information management with one shapefile per bairro and 20 historical Access databases containing talhão data. This establishes cadastral custody/context, not public vector availability.

nationalContext.name: Agência Nacional de Desenvolvimento Geo-Espacial (ADE) / MOZGIS
nationalContext.scope: National geospatial portal and public map-service context. The public Mocuba service is a health/locality map, not a cadastral parcel service.

service.name: No qualified public Mocuba parcel service; official MOZGIS Mocuba FeatureServer inspected as adjacent public map source
service.viewerConfiguration: The official REST service metadata lists Concentration point, Health facility, and Locality boundary (Mocuba - INE 2017) layers only. The locality layer uses EPSG:32737 and has polygon geometry, but it is an administrative/locality boundary and was not retained as parcel evidence.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official service metadata returned three non-parcel layers; no parcel layer, parcel native ID field, or parcel geometry endpoint was present. Response saved in ignored scratch evidence.
Official locality-boundary schema returned polygon geometry in EPSG:32737 with fid and administrative fields. This is not parcel data; no feature was retained.
Bounded request did not produce a usable response within the attempt. This is not evidence of an exact-point miss or citywide parcel absence.
Official REST catalog root returned folders/services. Bounded folder inspection did not qualify a Mocuba parcel service.
Request stopped at certificate verification; no TLS bypass was used because no source-specific exception was authorized.

scratchEvidence: tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/mocuba/ (official service metadata and bounded request outputs; no unsafe fields retained)
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native cadastral parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [-16.8444463824618, 36.9814819548574] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
Municipal cadastral-system evidence does not establish that its ArcGIS/shapefiles are publicly accessible or currently published as an anonymous parcel API.
The inspected MOZGIS Mocuba layers are health and administrative/locality layers, not parcels; no GeoJSON parcel sample is retained.
Timeouts and TLS verification failure are access/qualification limits, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, DUAT-detail, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The municipal ArcGIS system and historical Access databases may be private, separately hosted, or not exposed through the national MOZGIS catalog.
No current public viewer JavaScript/configuration for the municipal parcel system was found.
No independent serial reviewer has qualified a runtime adapter.
